title: Overloads will be ambiguous when passing lambda arguments.
summary: It is an experimental check, so Error Prone does not turn it on by default.

title: Casting a lambda to this @FunctionalInterface can cause a behavior change from casting to a functional superinterface, which is surprising to users. Prefer decorator methods to this surprising behavior.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Return value of methods returning Future must be checked. Ignoring returned Futures suppresses exceptions thrown from the code that completes the Future.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Use transform instead of transformAsync when all returns are an immediate future.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: Futures.getChecked requires a checked exception type with a standard constructor.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.

title: DoubleMath.fuzzyEquals should never be used in an Object.equals() method.
summary: Error Prone turns it on by default.
